availability.value: Sold new by Audi Pakistan; delivery in about 2 months (PakWheels, January 2026). A lower-powered e-tron GT quattro is also listed (see notes).

notes.value: Audi RS e-tron GT, first generation, as sold in Pakistan. Per Audi's data sheet: 93.4 kWh battery (83.7 kWh usable) on an 800-volt system, 440 kW (590 hp) and 475 kW (637 hp) on boost, 830 Nm, all-wheel drive with a two-speed rear gearbox and a controlled rear differential lock, 0–100 km/h in 3.3 s with boost (3.6 s without), 250 km/h, 447–496 km WLTP at 19.8–22.1 kWh/100 km; PakNEV estimates about 404 km in real-world use. DC charging up to 270 kW with 5–80% in 22.5 min; AC 11 kW (22 kW optional), about 9.5 hours. 4,989 × 1,964 × 1,414 mm on a 2,900 mm wheelbase, 125 mm ground clearance (PakNEV), 350 L boot plus a front trunk, 2,345 kg, four doors and 4+1 seats, 20-inch wheels. PKR 57,000,000 ex-factory (PakWheels, January 2026; PakNEV the same). Also offered: the e-tron GT quattro (350 kW / 469 hp, 630 Nm, 4.1 s, 245 km/h, up to 502 km WLTP), whose price sources disagree — PKR 44,000,000 on PakNEV, PKR 58,000,000 on Gari.pk — so confirm it with Audi Pakistan. Warranty 5 years / 150,000 km, battery 8 years / 160,000 km. The 2025 facelift (97 kWh, up to 912 hp) is not the car sold here. Sources: Audi data sheet (May 2024), PakWheels, PakNEV.
